item.title: Nike’s OG "Neon" Air Max Is Even Cleaner as a Skate Shoe
item.description: Nike SB's Air Max Ishod sneaker slips into the iconic "Neon" outfit borrowed from the OG Air Max 95 sneaker. Admittedly, it looks even better as a skate shoe.

item.title: Nike’s Loveliest Air Jordans Wear Pretty Pink Denim
item.description: Nike's Air Jordan 4 "Iced Carmine" sneaker lands as a pink denim take on the classic Jumpman model.

item.title: High-Tech Running Shoes Are Cool Again
item.description: High-tech running shoes from New Balance, adidas, Nike & HOKA are finally as stylish as their low-fi counterparts, ushering in a new era of suave sneakers.

item.title: Outside of Sports, FILA Looks Great Buttoned up
item.description: Sportswear isn't FILA's only job. The brand's FW26 campaign proves that high-fashion is might just be FILA's one true calling.

item.title: Hello Kitty’s Insanely Cute Converse Chuck Taylors Are Swarovski-Studded
item.description: Hello Kitty gets its own $352 Swarovski-covered Converse Chuck Taylor sneaker for a new collaboration.

item.title: New Balance's Croc Grandad Shoe Is England-Made, Swamp-Raised
item.description: New Balance's Allerdale Made in U.K. sneaker gets a luxurious crocodile leather makeover for an exclusive release at END.

item.title: Patta's Nike Air Max 1 Is Still the Wave
item.description: Patta's Nike Air Max 1 sneaker isn't just riding the chunky sneaker wave — it's leading the charge.

item.title: adidas' Most Exquisite Ballet Sneaker Is a Black Swan
item.description: adidas' Taekwondo Mei Elite sneaker gets a silky all-black makeover, a.k.a its cleanest colorway yet.

item.title: From Nike to ASICS, Browse This Week’s Best Sneaker Releases
item.description: This week’s selection is about all about... let's just say the days of quiet luxury are long behind us. From ASICS to adidas, everyone's all about eccentricity.

item.title: English Bikers Turned Japan's Finest Nylon Bags Into Leather Jackets
item.description: Lewis Leathers, the UK's oldest motorcycle apparel label, has transformed PORTER’s luxurious nylon bags into leather bags.
